name: Drupal.org project link filter
description: A filter to facilitate linking to Drupal.org projects and nodes.
project_description: Drupal.org project link filter (dopl) is a tiny single-plugin module that adds a text-format filter converting short shorthand tokens in body text into links to Drupal.org projects, nodes, issues, groups.drupal.org nodes and users. Authors write tokens such as "views.module", "pathauto.project", "345196.issue", "345196.do", "345196.gdo" or "48488.user"; the filter matches them, calls the Drupal.org api-d7 endpoints (or scrapes the groups.drupal.org page title) to resolve the real title and canonical URL, and renders an anchor. Results are cached permanently per token. Depends only on core filter; enabled per text format at /admin/config/content/formats. It is a 4.x dev branch with no tagged stable release, in maintenance-fixes-only status and not covered by Drupal's security advisory policy.
